layers.allowed_claim: Genome/source signature is stable under stated measurement.
layers.forbidden_claim: Source stability establishes identity, function, rejuvenation, or immortality.

layers.allowed_claim: A named cellular context is measured or annotated for the stated sample scope.
layers.forbidden_claim: Context annotation establishes age reversal, identity preservation, function, safety, or maintenance.

layers.allowed_claim: A paired methylation age-signature shift is measurable under a named clock.
layers.forbidden_claim: An age-clock shift establishes identity preservation, function, safety, rejuvenation, or immortality.

layers.allowed_claim: Cell identity is supported by named expression or marker evidence in the stated context.
layers.forbidden_claim: Identity-marker preservation establishes function, safety, renewable maintenance, organismal maintenance, or immortality.

layers.allowed_claim: A bounded cellular function is realized under a named functional assay.
layers.forbidden_claim: Function realization establishes safety, renewable maintenance, organismal maintenance, rejuvenation, or immortality.

layers.allowed_claim: A named safety boundary is measured under pluripotency, safety, expression, or perturbation contact.
layers.forbidden_claim: A safety boundary establishes durable renewal, organismal maintenance, rejuvenation, or immortality.

layers.allowed_claim: Renewable maintenance is supported by longitudinal cycle or perturbation evidence in the stated scope.
layers.forbidden_claim: Renewable maintenance establishes organismal maintenance, rejuvenation, or immortality.

layers.allowed_claim: Organismal maintenance is supported by organismal phenotype or bounded functional evidence.
layers.forbidden_claim: Organismal maintenance establishes immortality or unbounded rejuvenation.

layer_descriptions.genome_source: source-level genome or donor signature under stated measurement
layer_descriptions.context: sample, cell-state, or treatment context under stated assay scope
layer_descriptions.cell_identity: identity-marker or expression evidence for cell-type preservation
layer_descriptions.function_realization: bounded functional assay outcome in the stated cell context
layer_descriptions.safety_boundary: pluripotency, safety-assay, expression, or perturbation boundary evidence
layer_descriptions.renewable_maintenance: longitudinal cycle or perturbation evidence for repeated maintenance
layer_descriptions.organismal_maintenance: organismal phenotype or bounded organism-level function readback
